goal: Maximize profitable occupied apartment nights using verified demand, availability and paid reservations; no occupancy guarantee.

websiteEvents.page_view: Consented page visit with allowlisted page_language; not a unique person
websiteEvents.click_phone: Phone link click, not a completed call
websiteEvents.click_email: Email link click, not sent or delivered mail
websiteEvents.stay_planner_click: Opens stay planner, not language selection or reservation
websiteEvents.booking_click: Opens booking route or external engine, not a confirmed booking
websiteEvents.language_switch: Deliberate language switch; source_language and target_language; not a sales conversion

futureVerifiedEvents.availability_search: requires actual PMS search result; no guest data
futureVerifiedEvents.purchase: server-confirmed payment and PMS confirmation only; unique transaction deduplication

businessInputs: PMS available apartment nights by date
Contribution margin and owner-approved acquisition cost ceiling
decisionMetrics: Cost per verified enquiry when lead qualification exists
Net confirmed booking revenue per advertising spend
Occupancy by stay date; not by website visit date
rules: Do not optimize paid campaigns to page views or contact clicks as if they were paid bookings
Never invent purchase events before payment/PMS integration
Separate brand search from non-brand acquisition
Keep platform reported conversions separate from confirmed PMS totals
Do not start spending until budget and acquisition cost ceiling are approved
Use sufficient observed data before shifting budget; label small samples
Reduce or stop date-specific promotion when verified inventory is exhausted
requiredBeforeActivation: Consent and privacy documents synchronized in seven languages
Cloudflare production deployment access and live verification
GA4 DebugView received events after explicit consent
Advertising account access and data-sharing approval for each connection
Verified PMS/payment events before revenue optimization
